narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Any diamond with its corners on dots is a square.
<bookmark mark='tall'/>Mark corners two dots to the right and four dots up. That diamond is narrow and tall.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Its corners are not right angles, so being a diamond on dots does not make it a square.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check each figure, measure its sides with a ruler. A square has all four equal.
<bookmark mark='angles'/>Then measure its corners with a protractor. Squares and rectangles both have four right angles.
